QR564 million in property deals. In one week.

According to the Ministry of Justice weekly real estate bulletin, Qatar recorded about QR564.6 million in real estate trading between November 8 and 12: roughly QR505.8 million in registered sale contracts plus QR58.8 million in residential unit sales.

The week before (November 1–5) passed QR665 million.

For agencies, the total isn't the most useful part. The spread is. Sales were reported across Doha, Al Wakra, Umm Salal, Al Daayen, Al Khor and Al Thakhira, Al Shamal, Lusail 69 and The Pearl Island.

What it means for brokers:
→ Buyers are active in many areas at once, not only the prime districts.
→ Your stock in those areas needs to be live, accurate and on every portal.
→ When an enquiry lands, how fast your team replies decides who gets the viewing.

Three things to do this week:
• Refresh the listings you hold in the most active areas
• Take sold or stale listings off the portals
• Make sure every new lead reaches an agent the same day

(Keeping listings and leads in one place is exactly why we built OneLinker CRM.)
